title: Jimmy Allen passes for white and never comes back
summary: A light-skinned friend joins a white society band and later ignores Hinton from the front row in Detroit.

story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand

blocks.x: No dice. He never came backstage to say hello. Now we‟d be all over the place.
But he didn‟t want to be labeled [unintelligible].
Economically with everything else, socially and everything else.
Yeah. And there he sit in the first row so he could let me know that he was there. I‟m working my eyes and everything, come on back. No good [laugh]. So it was that kind of thing [unintelligible].
